article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-leaning hybrid
Genetics: Hot Rod × Sugar Daddy
Breeder: Dungeons Vault Genetics / Kush Company
THC Content: 27–35%
CBD Content: Below 1%
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , limonene , caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Diesel, citrus, pine, sweet spice, earth
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8-9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: October
Indoor Yield: Moderate
Outdoor Yield: Moderate
Grow Difficulty: Intermediate

Iceberg Slim does not announce itself like a typical modern candy strain . The first impression is closer to opening a jar of old-school California OG: sharp fuel, pine, damp earth, skunk, and citrus pushing outward before a sweeter layer begins to appear. Dense flowers can look almost frosted under strong light, and the potency found in recent batches places the cultivar firmly among the heavier marijuana options in the contemporary California market. Its personality is equally distinctive, beginning with an unexpectedly bright mental surge before gradually settling into the tranquil body effect for which Kush Company promotes the strain.

Its history is also more interesting than a simple brand-created hybrid. Kush Company selected Iceberg Slim from a small phenotype hunt after acquiring seed stock bred by Dungeons Vault Genetics. Four plants were evaluated, and phenotype #3 became the keeper ultimately released under the Kush Company name. The current version is identified as Hot Rod × Sugar Daddy, combining a spicy diesel influence with a sweeter citrus-driven counterpart. Because several unrelated cannabis varieties also use the Iceberg Slim name, confirming the producer is important when comparing genetics or effects.
Genetics and Lineage

Hot Rod provides the harder-edged side of the pedigree. Its contribution can be recognized in the strong petroleum quality, peppery spice, earthy undertones, and old-school gas character that frequently dominate the finished flower. Rather than producing a soft dessert aroma, this side of the family gives the weed a sharper profile that can suggest fuel, rubber, pine resin, and warm spice. It also fits the Kush Company preference for cultivars that retain classic OG-like intensity rather than leaning entirely toward modern fruit or candy genetics.

Sugar Daddy changes the equation by adding sweetness and citrus around that heavier foundation. In the selected Iceberg Slim phenotype, these traits do not erase the gas; instead, they soften its edges. Lemon peel, sweet citrus, and faint sugary notes can emerge underneath the diesel and pine, creating a more layered aroma than a straightforward OG-style plant . Kush Company’s selection of phenotype #3 appears to have favored this balance, preserving the heavy gas qualities while allowing enough sweetness to make the flavor unusually accessible.
Effects and Experience

The opening phase tends to arrive quickly. A strong batch may create a noticeable cerebral lift, brighter mood, increased sensory awareness, and a temporary burst of mental energy. Music can seem more detailed, conversation may feel more engaging, and familiar activities can become surprisingly absorbing. That initial stimulation explains why the strain can feel more balanced than its indica classification suggests, particularly when consumed in moderate quantities.

With time, the experience shifts downward into the body. Muscular tension begins to ease, the pace of thought becomes less urgent, and the energetic edge gradually gives way to a calmer state. Kush Company itself describes the progression as an initial rush followed by tranquility, which accurately captures the two-stage nature of the high. Potency deserves attention: recent batches have appeared above 30% THC, with some products reaching roughly the mid-30% range. At those levels, inexperienced consumers may encounter heavy sedation, impaired concentration, dry mouth, dizziness, or anxiety after taking too much.
Medical Benefits

Iceberg Slim has not been evaluated as an individual medical marijuana treatment in controlled clinical studies, so claims about specific therapeutic benefits should remain conservative. Its effect profile may nevertheless appeal to medical cannabis patients who prefer an initial improvement in mood followed by deeper physical relaxation. THC-dominant cultivars with similar characteristics are sometimes chosen by patients dealing with temporary discomfort, reduced appetite, stress, or difficulty relaxing toward the end of the day.

The high THC content can also work against certain patients. People sensitive to THC may experience increased anxiety, elevated heart rate, dizziness, or impaired short-term memory, particularly when consuming high-potency flower rapidly. Terpenes such as myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene contribute substantially to aroma, but their presence should not be treated as proof that this strain will address a particular medical condition. For medical use, the laboratory analysis of the actual batch is more meaningful than the strain name alone.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Gas is the backbone of the aroma, but Iceberg Slim is not one-dimensional. Freshly opened flower can release diesel, sharp pine, skunk, and earthy Kush before sweeter citrus becomes apparent. Lemon rind and orange-like brightness sometimes sit behind the heavier petroleum notes, while certain batches develop faint berry, woody, or sugary qualities. The combination creates a profile that feels simultaneously old-school and contemporary.

The smoke follows a similar progression. Diesel and spice tend to dominate the first impression, followed by citrus and a smoother sweetness through the middle of the inhale. Pine, earth, and slightly skunky gas remain on the palate afterward. Myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene have all been associated with Kush Company examples, providing a reasonable chemical explanation for the earthy, citrus, and peppery aspects of the bouquet. Even so, terpene ratios can move considerably between harvests.
Growing Information

Detailed breeder cultivation specifications for the Kush Company keeper have not been publicly released, so precise claims about flowering time or yield would be speculative. What can be observed from finished commercial flower is a tendency toward dense bud formation and substantial resin coverage, characteristics that make environmental management particularly important as flowers mature. Plants producing compact colas generally benefit from adequate spacing and airflow because moisture trapped inside dense flowering material can increase problems late in bloom.

The cultivar’s phenotype-selected nature is also worth understanding. Consumers normally encounter Kush Company’s keeper rather than a broad population of Iceberg Slim seedlings, meaning the familiar commercial flower represents one particular expression chosen from the original hunt. Growers working from authentic clone material should therefore expect greater consistency than someone searching through unrelated seeds carrying the same name. For anyone attempting to authenticate the plant, provenance is more useful than generic online descriptions of height, harvest date, or yield.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Iceberg Slim?

The Kush Company version covered here is identified as Hot Rod × Sugar Daddy. Kush Company selected phenotype #3 from a small hunt using seed stock attributed by the company to Dungeons Vault Genetics.
Who bred Iceberg Slim?
The seed genetics behind Kush Company’s cultivar came from Dungeons Vault Genetics, while Kush Company conducted the phenotype hunt and selected the keeper that became its commercial Iceberg Slim.
Is Iceberg Slim indica or sativa?

Kush Company categorizes the cultivar as indica. Its actual experience has a hybrid-like progression, however, beginning with noticeable cerebral uplift before becoming calmer and more physically relaxing.
How strong is Iceberg Slim?

Iceberg Slim can be exceptionally potent. Recent Kush Company flower has appeared from the upper-20% range into the mid-30% THC range, with examples around 31–34% being common in current retail batches. Actual potency should always be taken from the laboratory label on the package.
What does Iceberg Slim taste like?

Expect a combination of diesel, pine, citrus, earthy Kush, spice, and sweetness. Stronger gas and skunk qualities usually dominate, while lemon, orange, berry, or sugary notes may appear underneath depending on the harvest.
Final Thoughts on Iceberg Slim

Iceberg Slim succeeds because it bridges two different periods of cannabis flavor. The strain has enough sweetness and citrus to feel contemporary, yet its identity remains rooted in diesel, pine, skunk, and OG-like funk. That balance separates it from hybrids built almost entirely around candy terpenes. Add the unusually strong THC levels seen in recent flower, and the result is weed with both substantial intensity and a recognizable aromatic identity.

Its selection history is equally important. Kush Company did not simply attach a new name to an anonymous plant; the cultivar emerged from a phenotype hunt of Dungeons Vault Genetics material, with one plant ultimately earning keeper status. For consumers interested in potent California gas strains, that combination of breeder provenance, careful selection, high resin production, and a two-stage euphoric-to-relaxing effect gives Iceberg Slim a strong claim to attention beyond potency numbers alone.
